decisive_items: Dense granulomatous infiltrate in the upper dermis consisting of histiocytes, lymphocytes, foam cells, multinucleated giant cells, eosinophils, and hemorrhage
central diabetes insipidus, growth retardation, and hypothyroidism
response.rationale: The clinical picture of multisystem involvement (skin, endocrine) with biopsy showing non-Langerhans cell histiocytic infiltrate (CD68+, CD1a/S-100 negative) and foam cells is highly specific for Erdheim-Chester disease.
